symbols.name: InMemoryFileStorageProvider
symbols.summary: An in-memory implementation of IFileStorageProvider for testing or ephemeral storage, supporting both files and directories. Maintains a dictionary of files and a hash set of directories, ensuring thread-safe operations and hierarchical structure.
